Deep Rothé Calf is in Grymforge near the  Elder Rothé at X: -656 Y: 398. It can be spoken to with  Speak with Animals.
“
Afraid. Afraid of Thorm.
„
— Deep Rothé Calf

Involvement

Speaking to either  Elder Rothé or Deep Rothé Calf starts a joint conversation with them both. The rothé communicate using the spell  Dancing Lights, which (if not using  Speak with Animals) the party can observe to discern the emotions of the Elder Rothé: pain, sadness, and a fear stretching back generations.

With  Speak with Animals, the party can join in on the conversation. The Rothé speak of  Ketheric Thorm and his Dark Justiciar army, who have left their mark on the area: "the rock shivers from the sound. The Ketheric Thorm." The Elder Rothé has lived long enough that it worked during the time of Ketheric's war. It recounts the bloody battle and Thorm's army, and  Yurgir, the hellbeast that broke them.
